rules.source: 1003 姬子 星魂 6 开拓！ (Trailblaze!): 「终结技额外造成2次伤害，对随机敌方单体各造成等同于原伤害40%的火属性伤害。」 参数 [0.4]
rules.note: 「终结技额外造成 **2** 次伤害…等同于**原伤害 40%**」—— ① 事件 `DAMAGE_SETTLED` ✓（结算**之后**、**施加侧**、双阵营 ✓）；② `scale: original_damage` ✓（= amount ÷ 触发实例自己的因子 ✓）；③ `target: random_enemy` ✓（该选择器的**第一个读者** ✓）；④ `times: 2` ✓；⑤ **`damage_is_attack`** ✓ 与 ⑥ **`from_skill ULTRA`** ✓ —— ⭐ **两条都是必需的护栏** ✓，而本轮把它们的**实际效果**量准了 ✓：这条规则最终只对**她终结技自己那一发**（实测 amount **718.255731** ✓）生效 ✓ ⇒ 额外伤害 **2 × 0.4 × 718.255731 = 574.6045848** ✓（实测 **574.604585** ✓ 逐位吻合 ✓）；⚠ 而**同场里另有一发 10764.438828** 的实例 ✓（来自她**文件里别的规则** ✓，不是终结技）⇒ 它**必须不被本句缩放** ✓ —— 这正是「原伤害」指的是**这一发技能**而不是「整场掉血」 ✓，也是**为什么不能拿星魂 0 的总掉血当分母** ✗（那一发会把它抬到 11482.69 ✗ ⇒ 0.8 × 那个数就是错的期望 ✗，我为此白跑了两轮 ✓）。⑦ `min_eidolon: 6` ✓。⚠ **登记**：不区分「那 2 次是否打中同一个敌人」✗；也不处理「敌人不足 2 个」（随机取同一只 ✓）。

rules.source: 1003 姬子 天赋 乘胜追击 (100304) 的**等级口径**: 她的天赋在文档里按 Lv10 引用（row Lv10 = [1.4, 3]，即「140%攻击力」）
rules.note: This is the file stating **which level its own numbers were quoted at** (M-32), replacing the `damage_level: 10` that the follow-up rule used to carry. ⚠ The two are not the same statement: `damage_level` pins ONE effect to a row, while a level is a fact about the skill — every effect that reads it sees the same level, and a 星魂's raise composes with it instead of being ignored. ⚠ The base is 1 in the engine (a character has no progression model), so 「the document quotes Lv10」 is +9. ⚠ It is unconditional and is not a mechanic (no `min_eidolon`, no `when`). ⚠ Her talent's table has 15 rows, so a later raise stays inside it; a raise past the table fails loudly at fire time instead of reading nothing.

rules.source: 1003 姬子 天赋 乘胜追击 (100304) 第3句: 「战斗开始时获得1点充能。」
rules.note: No `when`: BATTLE_START is fired once to every character's table with no actor and no target (TriggerTable refuses a carried-party condition on it), and this sentence has no condition. No `target` either -- GAIN_RESOURCE defaults to the rule's owner, which is the only unit the sentence names. ⚠ The op is fired through ResourceManager.gain, whose default overflow is 0, so 「上限3点」 is enforced by the declaration above rather than by the rule.

rules.source: 1003 姬子 天赋 乘胜追击 (100304) 第1句: 「当有敌方目标的弱点被击破时，姬子获得充能，上限3点。」
rules.note: No condition: BREAK is fired with the broken enemy as the event's subject and is only ever emitted for an enemy (Battle.reduceStance → enemy.breakEnemy), so 「敌方目标的弱点被击破」 is what the event already is. ⚠ Deliberately NOT gated on `actor == self`: the text pays for a break by anyone (which is also why the rule lives on her own table and nobody else's). Set 111's 「装备者击破敌方目标弱点后」 is the same event read the other way, with `actor == self` -- both spellings are pinned by their own tests. ⚠ This is the only rule of hers that can push 充能 to 3 without her acting: an ally's break charges her follow-up.

rules.source: 1003 姬子 星魂 4 坚守的心 (Avatar_Himeko_Rank04) 第二句: 「施放<u>战技</u>对敌方目标造成弱点击破时，姬子额外获得1点充能。」
rules.note: 「**施放战技**对敌方目标造成弱点击破时」 — two conditions, and both are load-bearing: `actor == self` says the break was hers (the talent rule above pays for anybody's break, which is what ITS sentence says), and `from_skill SKILL` says the instance that broke the toughness came from her **战技** — not from her 普攻, not from her 天赋's follow-up attack. ⚠ Without the second one, `actor == self` would also pay when her follow-up (a rule-driven `DAMAGE` with `skill: "TALENT"`, which carries `SkillCategory.UNSPECIFIED`) leaves the break — a wrong +1 充能 with nothing to report. The attribution comes from the instance itself (`Damage.getCastCategory()`, read by the `from_skill` condition against `SkillCategory.of(SkillType.SKILL)` = `BPSKILL`), which `Battle.reduceToughness` now carries into the BREAK event. ⚠ `min_eidolon: 4` is the gate; ⚠ the cap 「上限3点」 is the resource declaration's, so this rule can push her to the cap and no further. ⚠ This 星魂's other sentence is the ultimate's per-kill energy rule below.

rules.source: 1003 姬子 终结技 留待残烬 (100303, AoEAttack/Ultra) 第二句: 「每消灭1个敌方目标额外恢复姬子5点能量。」 param Lv10 = [1.38, 5] → #2 = 5
rules.note: 「每消灭1个敌方目标**额外**恢复姬子5点能量」 — 「额外」 is why this is a rule at all, and the reading is not a guess: ① the skill's own `param_list` Lv10 is `[1.38, 5]`, i.e. the document states this 5; ② the engine's **general** kill credit (`Constant.ENERGY_GAIN_KILL`, `StandardEnergyProvider.onKill`) is folded into the attack's own energy (`Battle.grantHitAndKillEnergy`: one attack grants energy once), so it is not this sentence's 5; ③ the text says 「**额外**恢复」. Measured 2026-09-28 (`HimekoKillEnergyTest`): a 1-HP enemy killed by her ultimate pays **10** against **5** for the same cast that does not kill — the difference is exactly this rule — and a kill caused by an ally pays her **0**. ⚠ `from_skill ULTRA` keeps it to kills **her ultimate** caused: `actor == self` alone would also pay for a kill from her 普攻/战技/天赋 follow-up, and the sentence names the ultimate. ⚠ No `target`: 「为姬子恢复」 is GAIN_ENERGY's default. ⚠ No `min_eidolon`: this is the ultimate's own sentence (base kit), unlike 星魂 4 above. ⚠ `KILL` carries the killer as `actor`, the victim as the subject, and the causing instance's cast category.

rules.source: 1003 姬子 天赋 乘胜追击 (100304) 第2句: 「当我方目标施放攻击后，若姬子的充能达到上限则立即发动1次追加攻击，对敌方全体目标造成等同于姬子140%攻击力的火属性伤害，并消耗全部充能。」
rules.note: Three things are stated here and one is not, on purpose. ① The trigger 「当我方目标施放攻击后」 is ALLY_ATTACK (fired by SkillExecutor for every one of our attacks, its own included); ② the gate 「充能达到上限」 is `self_resource:充能 >= 3` -- the cap, read from the declaration above rather than repeated as a literal nobody could check, and `>=` rather than `==` because 「达到上限」 is a threshold, not an equality; ③ the swing's numbers are NOT written here: `skill: "TALENT"` + `damage_param: 0` + `damage_level: 10` reads 1.4 out of skill 100304's own parameter row (index 0 = the multiplier; the row is [0.7, 3] at Lv1 and [1.4, 3] at Lv10 -- use `damage_param: 1` and the rule would read the *cap*, 3, which happens to equal 3.0, i.e. a wrong number that looks right), and the Fire element and the all-enemy shape come from the same skill data. ⚠ `damage_level: 10` is required rather than decorative: a character's skills are all at level 1 in this engine, so the skill's own level would read the Lv1 row (0.7) while the text quotes the Lv10 row (1.4) -- half the damage, with nothing to report. ⚠ `target: "all_enemies"` is the enemy-side group selector (added for this sentence): every other group selector reads `battle.allies`, so 「敌方全体」 had no spelling and DAMAGE reached one unit at a time. ⚠ The follow-up is settled by `Battle.applyAdditionalDamage`, which is the engine's one notion of a follow-up attack and emits FOLLOW_UP; it does not count as an attack, so this rule cannot re-trigger itself. ⚠ 「消耗全部充能」 is `amount: 3` and that is not an approximation of "all": the rule only runs at the cap, and the cap IS 3. ⚠ ✅ 两处曾经登记的句子都已出货（2026-09-28），各有自己的规则与测试：① 终结技「每消灭1个敌方目标额外恢复姬子5点能量」→ 本文件下面的 `KILL` 规则（`actor == self` + `from_skill ULTRA` + `+5`；「额外」的依据是技能 `param_list` 自己写着 5、通则击杀回能被折进这次攻击的自身能量、以及「额外」这个词；`HimekoKillEnergyTest` 2 条）；② 星魂 4 「施放战技对敌方目标造成弱点击破时，姬子额外获得1点充能」→ 本文件上面的 `BREAK` 规则（`actor == self` + `from_skill SKILL` + `+1` 充能；`SkillAttributionTest` 11 条）。⚠ 这两句当初都卡在同一个缺口上——「这件事**是哪条技能**造成的」——它由 `from_skill` 条件在 2026-09-28 补上（见 `engine.md`）。③ 星魂 3/5 are the skill-level gap (M-32).

rules.source: 1003 行迹: 「对当前生命值百分比小于等于50%的敌方目标造成的伤害提高15%」（0.15 见她自己行迹 1003103 的 param）
rules.note: 「对**当前生命值百分比小于等于 50%** 的敌方目标造成的伤害提高 **15%**」—— ① 条件 **`target_hp_percent <= 0.5`** ✓（**分数** ✓）；⭐ **本条件在 `DEALING_DAMAGE` 上有效这一点是实测的** ✓（第 107/270 轮探针：伤员臂 share=0.387 ⇒ **触发** ✓、满血臂 share=0.987 ⇒ **不触发** ✓）；② 事件 `DEALING_DAMAGE` ✓ + `BOOST_DAMAGE` ✓（加的是**本次伤害实例** ✗ ⇒ 判据看**伤害数字** ✓）；⚠ ③ **判据必须用单段攻击** ✓：探针同时显示一次战技会结算 **2 段**（`ruleFired=2` ✓）⇒ 段数一多，实例加成在**求和**后被稀释 ✓（第 106/270 轮实测比值只有 1.0057 ✗ 就是这么来的 ✗）⇒ 本轮改用**普攻**（单段 ✓）；④ ⭐ 数值**经查找核实** ✓：`0.15` 在她**自己的行迹 `1003103`** 的 `param` 里 ✓。 ⚠⚠ **2026-09-29 补守卫** ✓：引擎的 `fireTriggers` **遍历全队** ✓（`Battle:2136`）⇒ **没有 `actor == self` 的 `DEALING_DAMAGE` 规则会对队友的伤害也生效** ✗，而本句说的是「**她**造成的伤害」✓ ⇒ 补守卫 ✓（实测前：队友伤害也被加成 ✗）。
